title: Pasive Skill Tree  | Tabla's New Icons & More
description: A pack that adds 50+ icons, 20+ border frames and more to Daripher's Passive Skill Tree mod. Originally made for the modpack Soulrend by Apotheotic Studios in curseforge.
body:
(Originally in Curse Forge)
Huge thanks to Daripher for letting me upload this resourcepack!

As you read, this resourcepack focuses on adding more new icons and frames for you to use. In the future I will add more icons but do keep in mind these are all being made for a modpack first. If you use this resourcepack for your own skilltrees, please take note of this, as any requests for new icons or frames will be done on a different priority.

Other than that, most of the new icons come in as many colours as possible. For now, this is a beta and some things will change in the future, be sure to read the changelogs when there is a new update before installing in case of file name changes.

You will find the icons in the same folders and editor the mod has by default. You can use it in a modpack no issues but do credit!
Have fun!

All of them in different colours like red, orange, yellow, lime, cyan, teal, blue and more.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f273ed948ce777eb9ec700ea9151752c652743a.png)
